results.description:
'Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.'

Published in 1948, How to Stop Worrying and Start Living is one of the first self-help books to hit the shelves to great success, with 30 million copies now sold worldwide.

An international bestseller, How to Stop Worrying and Start Living is essential reading for any overthinker. With time-tested techniques and practical advice, Carnegie illustrates exactly how to let go of fear, lower stress and say goodbye to anxiety for good. Including advice on how to manage money worries, effectively problem solve and foster a positive attitude, Carnegie's book is packed with simple-step solutions, magic formulas and helpful laws to live by to conquer any worrying situation. As relevant now as it was during its initial publication, How to Stop Worrying and Start Living is a timeless piece of self-improvement literature which continues to resonate with many.

Dale Carnegie (1888 – 1955) was an American writer. A self-improvement advocate, Carnegie worked in corporate training, offering courses on public speaking and interpersonal skills. He is famed for his runaway bestseller, How to Win Friends and Influence People, which remains hugely popular to this day.
